name: Diviner temperature-product ingest and interpolation verification
purpose: Verify metadata-driven D03 ingestion and interpolation without using model residuals.
production_capability: Diviner-backed surface-temperature boundary and Paige/Williams bolometric observation operator.
configuration: Strict frozen CSV schema, a deterministic 2x2x2 affine temperature fixture, native RDR mask fixtures, published Paige et al. channel sensitivity floors, and an analytical grey-surface fixture.
inputs: cold positive C9 with one-sigma uncertainty larger than its mean
independent_reference: Exact native-node value, hand-computed trilinear affine-field midpoint, epsilon^(1/4) T Stefan-Boltzmann identity, and round-trip inversion of the monotonically integrated Planck radiance.
units: K, degrees, hours local solar time, W m^-2, W m^-2 sr^-1
frame_time_convention: Product longitude/LST convention transformed explicitly to the production lunar frame.
procedure: Load the deterministic processed-format fixture through the production loader, reproduce a native node, evaluate the eight-corner midpoint and propagated uncertainty, verify locale-independent RDR UTC and exact native quality-mask decisions, verify radiance-coordinate native calibration inversion, verify the published low-sensitivity substitution chain, exercise local-Jacobian T_bol uncertainty propagation when the C9 one-sigma interval crosses zero, verify the grey-surface bolometric identity, and invert C6-C9 diagnostic rectangular-band Planck radiances.
metrics: zero local sensitivity of substituted channels
acceptance_criteria: Native nodes and declared parser/mask identities exact; interpolation and diagnostic channel inversions <=1e-12 relative to independent identities; grey bolometric temperature <=1e-14 relative; invalid values never interpolate silently; every below-threshold channel follows the published next-longer-channel rule. Rectangular passbands are diagnostic verification only and are not the I17 bolometric acceptance oracle.
expected_pass_result: Diviner temperatures enter production with documented coordinates and the model is converted from kinetic temperature to a matching blackbody-equivalent observation without invented data.
data_hashes: none; the affine fixture is an analytical kernel oracle and I16 owns D03 scoring
status_semantics: PASS verifies strict processed-product ingestion/interpolation and local observation-operator mathematics only; it is neither I16 nor I17 observational agreement.
